shared_job_description: Backend Software Engineer. We build distributed services in Python and Go, running on Kubernetes behind a Postgres + Redis + Kafka data plane. You will design REST and gRPC APIs, own on-call for the service you ship, write integration tests, and improve observability. Nice to have: AWS, Terraform, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry, event-driven architectures, performance tuning.
notes: 70 realistic resume-bullet rewrites authored by hand. Resume contexts are 1-3 sentences and reflect intern/new-grad reality (small teams, class/hackathon projects, modest scale). Hallucination types cover six classes: invented_metric, fabricated_tool, inflated_scope, false_outcome, timeline_fabrication, team_size_inflation. Faithful rewrites include pure rephrasing, adding true tech keywords, and clarifying scale that IS stated.
